note: Consequences of killing a police officer (user: 'Fully lethal everywhere'). Heat is Gameplay's; this is flavour. Teddy's lines are a meaningful contrast with his always-available non-lethal option.

lines.text: Central to all cars: officer down, {street} and {avenue}. All units. All units.
Central, the officer is not breathing. Repeat: not breathing.
All precincts: shooter of a police officer. Description follows. Use extreme caution.
Central to all cars: a moment of silence on the air for car one-four. …Back to work.
(Teddy) I wore that uniform. Eight years. God forgive me.
(Teddy) Some kid from Bay Ridge. He had a mother. Everybody's got a mother.
(Teddy) Kearney will hear about this before I'm off the block.
(Teddy) Down, not dead. Cuffs on his own wrist. He'll go home tonight.
(Teddy) Old habits. You don't shoot a man you'd have bought coffee for.
(Delphine) Rule twenty-one: they'll never stop looking now. Never.
(Nick) I'm a furrier! I'm a furrier! What have I done?
They shot a cop. On Eighth Avenue. They shot a cop.
Get inside. Every cop in the city is coming here.
